title: nemcia cuneata var. dilatata
intro: Nemcia cuneata var. dilatata, commonly known as Nemcia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Nemcia include immunomodulation, anti-protozoal, and antiparasitic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
